name: Rafiki
intro: You will meet Rafiki for the first time by TYPING (no talking needed): give your friend a name and a face, tell it a little about your family, ask it to remember one thing, then come back and see it remembers you. Turn your sound on if you like — Rafiki talks out loud.

steps.do: When the app opens, a “Welcome to Rafiki” card is at the bottom. Tap the small link “skip the tour” at its bottom-right.
steps.see: The card changes to “🎉 You’re ready” with a “Let’s go ›” button.
steps.tip: A green greeting may show at the top for a few seconds — it goes away by itself.

steps.see: A friendly page says “Well, hello there.” with a big “Say hello →” button.
Chat bubbles appear: “Well hello! 👋 I’ve been hoping you’d come.” and “…What would you like to call me?”. After a few seconds a typing box (“my new name”) appears with a “Send” button.
steps.tip: Don’t tap “🎤 Talk” in this test — we type everything.

steps.see: Nothing happens — no new bubble appears.

steps.do: Tap the typing box, type the name below, and tap “Send”.
steps.see: Your friend says “Sunny O'Day. Sunny O'Day! I love it — that’s me, forever. 🎉”, the name at the top now reads “Sunny O'Day”, and then it offers voices to pick from (like “Grace — a warm American woman”).
“That’s Grace. Shall I keep this voice, or would you like to hear another?” with buttons “✓ Keep Grace” and “↺ Let me hear another”.
steps.tip: If Grace isn’t in the list, tap whichever voice is first — the buttons will use that name instead.

steps.see: It says “Grace it is…” and then asks “Now the important part: what should I call you?”

steps.do: Type the name below in the box and tap “Send”.
steps.see: “Good to finally meet you, Margaret.” and three greeting buttons: “Good morning, Margaret!”, “Hey Margaret!” and “Morning, sunshine ☀️”.
It asks “Now tell me about your people. Are you married?” with buttons “Yes 💍”, “No” and “It’s complicated 😄”.

steps.do: Instead of tapping a button, type the name below and tap “Send”.
steps.see: “Harold — noted, and lucky them. I’ll remember.” Then it asks “Do you have any kids or grandkids?”
“More cake for us, then. 😊” and then “One more people-question: any pets running the household?” with a “No pets” button.
“A quiet kingdom. Respect.” then “Last one for today — pick my face!” with ten face buttons (🙂 🦉 🌻 🐝 …).
The face at the top changes to 🌻 and it says “That’s your people sorted. 💛 I’m Sunny O'Day…”. Two buttons appear: “🗓 Yes — let’s do my week” and “Not now — I’ve had enough”.
“So — what now? Your list is empty…” with a column of buttons starting “➕ Put something on my list”.

steps.do: Tap “➕ Put something on my list” (it says “➕ Add something to it” if your One Thing list on this phone already has things).
steps.see: “Tell me what to remember — say it like you’d say it to a friend.”

steps.do: Type the reminder below and tap “Send”.
steps.see: “Got it. “Call Ann about Sunday dinner” — it’s on your One Thing list too, with my name on it.” and then “Your list has 1 or more things waiting…”.
It answers “I know Margaret — my favorite person, married to Harold…”.

steps.do: Pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: A welcome page with the 🌻 face says “Welcome back, Margaret.” and “It’s Sunny O'Day…”, with a “Say hello →” button.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Then tap “Say hello →”.
steps.see: It still works with no internet: it greets you by name with today’s date, says your list has things waiting (Call Ann), and asks if you’d like the weather. iPhone Safari only: a card “Keep Rafiki on your Home Screen” may slide up at the bottom. On Android or a computer you will not see that card — that is fine. (The voice may sound different after a reload — that is your phone choosing a voice.)

steps.do: If the Home Screen card is showing, tap “Later”. Then tap “No thanks” for the weather, then turn Airplane Mode off.
steps.see: The card goes away and Rafiki says “No weather, then — nothing leaves this phone.” followed by your list (1 thing waiting) and the buttons again.
